# iotype

> AI web services for Persian, English and Arabic: real-time speech recognition, audio file transcription, OCR for images and PDFs, machine translation, and text-to-speech. One bearer-token HTTP API plus a WebSocket channel for streaming ASR. Usage is metered in tokens; failed requests are not billed.

Base URL: `https://iotype.com`. Every endpoint is `POST` and requires `Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>`, `Accept: application/json` and `X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest`.

`POST /io/v1/ocr` and `POST /io/v1/transcribe` are asynchronous: they return a file object with a `uuid`, and you poll `POST /io/v1/file/track` until a process carries a non-null `result`.

## Specifications

- [OpenAPI 3.1 spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iotype-ai/iotype-api/main/spec/openapi.yaml): Complete machine-readable definition of all HTTP endpoints, schemas, enums, examples and error responses. Use this to generate clients.
- [AsyncAPI 3.0 spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iotype-ai/iotype-api/main/spec/asyncapi.yaml): The real-time ASR WebSocket channel — handshake message, binary audio format, and partial/final result messages.

## Guides

- [Authentication](https://iotype.com/api-service/authentication): Bearer token setup. Every HTTP endpoint authenticates with an Access Token, which belongs on your server only. A Flash Token is short-lived, single-use, and scoped exclusively to the realtime ASR WebSocket — no HTTP endpoint accepts one.
- [Realtime ASR](https://iotype.com/api-service/speech-to-text): Streaming speech-to-text over `wss://iotype.com/socket/realtime`. Handshake is `{"config":{"model":"io-fa","type":"access_token","token":"..."}}`; the server replies `{"status":"authorized","sample_rate":N}` and you must resample audio to N Hz — it is not a fixed value. Audio is raw binary PCM 16-bit mono little-endian in 20 ms frames. Results arrive as `{"partial":"..."}` (interim) and `{"text":"..."}` (settled), distinguished by which key is present. Send `{"eof":1}` before closing or the last utterance is lost.
- [Transcription](https://iotype.com/api-service/transcription): `POST /io/v1/transcribe/instant` for short clips (synchronous) and `POST /io/v1/transcribe` for long recordings (asynchronous, higher accuracy).
- [OCR](https://iotype.com/api-service/ocr): `POST /io/v1/ocr` converts PDF and JPG to text, with optional summarisation. Works on scanned and text-layer PDFs. Text only — no charts or tables.
- [Translation](https://iotype.com/api-service/translation): `POST /io/v1/translate` between `fa`, `en` and `ar`. Synchronous.
- [Text to speech](https://iotype.com/api-service/text-to-speech): `POST /io/v1/synthesis` returns a URL to a generated MP3. Eleven voices, two tones.

## Optional

- [Browser ASR client example](https://github.com/iotype-ai/iotype-api/tree/main/examples/browser-asr): A complete, tested browser implementation of the realtime protocol — microphone capture, resampling, framing and teardown in ~100 lines of dependency-free JavaScript.
- [Instructions for AI coding assistants](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iotype-ai/iotype-api/main/AGENTS.md): Concentrated rules, the async polling pattern, and the list of behaviours that are commonly generated incorrectly.
- [Pricing](https://iotype.com/plans/api): Token packages. New accounts receive 300 free tokens.
